title: Nighttime Sunwatch
text:
🌕 Nighttime Sunwatch — October 29, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B2.4)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B6.4 (Peaked October 28, 2026 at 12:52 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 320 km/s (Calm)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 0.67)
🚨 NOAA Watch: Geomagnetic Storm Category G1 Predicted

Everything looks pretty calm. 🤍🌞

A broad coronal-hole-like region and several modestly bright EUV regions are visible, while no sunspots or clear CME signature stand out.

Image: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 171 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
